scope: Production NPC/factory/brain compiled and executed on .NET8 against deterministic Unity/health/navigation substitutes. No native Unity, PhysX, Animator or Profiler execution.

tests.output:
Lethal strike completed without moving the parked CharacterController.
Death strike lifecycle: 318 assertions passed; production Health + NPC + Director, strict inactive CharacterController stand-in. Not a native Unity crash reproduction.
NPC brain, archetypes, crowd and melee geometry: 1960 assertions passed. Pure production logic; no Unity physics or rendering.

Distant eye-ray sampling: 13 queries /100 updates over1 second (old controller:100). Near-melee rays remain immediate.
Mixed eight-actor crowd: minimum center separation=0.638m, capsule gap=0.030m, attackers with an opportunity=8/8 over12s (kinematic stand-in, no PhysX).
Heavy eight-actor crowd: minimum center separation=0.747m, capsule gap=0.030m, attackers with an opportunity=8/8 over12s (kinematic stand-in, no PhysX).
NPC runtime/factory: 19917 assertions passed with narrow Unity/health/navigation stand-ins. Not Unity or PhysX execution.

customization: Base profile values multiply five bounded Inspector fields: runnerHealthMultiplier, runnerSpeedMultiplier, heavyHealthMultiplier, heavySpeedMultiplier, heavyDamageMultiplier. Scale and timing multipliers are fixed in the pure archetype tuning.

crowd.scope: Measured kinematic stress scenarios without PhysX pushes. Authored obstacle routing is checked using deterministic segment results.
crowd.approach: Target-specific stable lanes; a stable outer orbit for far-side positions; avoidance of neighbors with any target; two radial half-plane projection passes followed by exact final-step swept-circle clipping. Navigation rejects blocked final motion.
crowd.reuse: Disable, death, target change, emergence and reset release the lane/orbit. Pooled visuals/materials are reused. Variant tint preserves alpha and unrelated property overrides. Uniform scale is included in the distance-based walk cadence.

nativeDiagnostics: ActiveActorCount/GetActiveActor(index), LifeVersion and ResolvedStrikeVersion expose allocation-free evidence. ResolvedStrikeVersion increments exactly once at the real brain strike boundary for a hit or miss and resets per life.
